articles.title: BRICS leaders voice concern over Middle East, condemn unilateral sanctions at India summit - PBS
articles.description: The meeting, which included Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, voiced concern over “deliberate attacks” on civilian infrastructure and peaceful nuclear facilities under the U.N. atomic energy agency's safeguards.
